text: 中欧贸易投资磋商机制第二次例会成果共识清单：双方赞同提升全球产业链供应链可预期性与稳定性的重要性。中方愿通过“绿色通道”机制，为稀土及永磁体对欧出口许可审批继续提供便利。欧方将继续与成员国一道，为解决两用领域对华重点许可个案提供便利。（商务部网站）
text_en: List of outcomes and consensus of the second regular meeting of the China-EU Trade and Investment Consultation Mechanism: Both sides agree on the importance of enhancing the predictability and stability of global industrial and supply chains. China is willing to continue facilitating the approval of export licenses for rare earths and permanent magnets to the EU through the "green channel" mechanism. The EU will continue to work with member states to facilitate solutions to key licensing cases involving China in dual-use fields. (Ministry of Commerce website)
